songs.title: Cielo Abierto
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
[G] [D] [Em] [C]

[Verse]
[G]Sobre nosotros [D]tu presencia
[Em]llena este lu[C]gar
[G]Cielo abier[D]to, gloria que [Em]desciende[C]

[Chorus]
[C]Santo, [G]santo [D]eres tú
[Em]toda la tierra [C]canta [D]a ti

songs.title: Tu Fidelidad

[Chorus]

[F#m]digno eres [D]tú
[A]Aleluya, [E]aleluya

songs.title: Fuego en el Altar
songs.lyrics:
[Verse]

[Chorus]

songs.lyrics:

[Chorus]
